newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Benton County PUB #1, Wash..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Benton County PUB #1, Wash..

text.p: Benton County Public Utility District No. 1, WA
Electric Revenue Capital Asset Acquisition and Refunding
Sealed Proposals will be received at the office of Preston Gates & Ellis, LLP, bond counsel, for the purchase of the above-referenced Bonds, until 10:00 a.m., Seattle time, on

(or such other date to be communicated through Munifacts News Service at least 24 hours prior to the sale date). The Bonds will be dated April 1, 1997 and will be in book-entry form through DTC. The Bonds will mature on November 1 in the years 1999 through 2017. The Bonds maturing in the years 2008 through 2017 are subject to optional redemption prior to maturity. The legality of the Bonds will be approved by Preston Gates & Ellis, LLP.

Copies of the preliminary official statement, Official Notice of Sale and Official Bid Form and a copy of the Bond Resolution may be obtained from the District's Financial Advisor, Seagraves & Hein Capital Advisors, 200 W. Thomas, Suite 340, Seattle, WA 98119, 206/285-3221.
